title: China Adds More Missile Cells to Frigate, Narrowing Gap With US
title_cn: 中国为护卫舰增加导弹单元，缩小与美国的差距
summary: China appears to be adding more capacity to store and fire missiles on its most advanced frigate model, satellite imagery shows, as the world’s largest navy continues to close the gap with the US in firepower.
